fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) IPO'd on Nasdaq with ticker FB in 2012, changed company name and switched ticker to META in 2021 following concentrated metaverse investment.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta is the world's largest social media platform with over 3B monthly active users, and net income of $9.86B in Q3 2026 increased approximately 264% year-over-year.
